speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: He said maybe we should enter you in the killer robot competition.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Howard, the phone is ringing!

text: Here's a crazy idea, Ma, answer it!

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Hello? All right, hold on. It's your friend, Leonard! He wants to know why you're not at school today!

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I don't go to school, Ma. I work at a university. I don't want to talk to anybody.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: That's a school! Now pick up the phone! Should I ask Leonard to bring over your homework?!

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I don't have homework. I'm a grown man with a master's degree in engineering!

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Excuse me, Mr. Fancy-Pants. Want me to get you a Popsicle?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Cherry, please!

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: I ate the cherry. All that's left is green.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You make me want to kill myself.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What's going on?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't know, now they're just yelling about Popsicles. Sounds like Penny really got to him.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I'm not surprised. Despite his hard and crusty shell, Howard is a very sensitive man. Do you know he writes poetry? Mostly about men from Nantucket and hermits named Dave, but he does it with real sensitivity.

text: Hey, Hofstadter. Word around the pwasma wab is you built a wobot?

text: Yes, we did, Kripke.

text: Well, if you have any dewusions about entewing him against my wobot, the Kwipke Kwippler in the Southern California Wobot Fighting League Wound Wobin Invitational, aka the S.C.aw.F.L.aw.aw.I., his name is gonna be Swrap Metal.

text: Leonard, I believe it is. This is trash talk, and trash talk is a traditional component in all sporting events.
